newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia's Ingosstrakh insures Comstar for $100 mln.
newsitem.headline: Russia's Ingosstrakh insures Comstar for $100 mln.

text.p: Russia's second biggest insurer, SAO Ingosstrakh, signed a $100 million, one-year insurance contract with Russian-British telecommunications firm Comstar, Ingosstrakh officials said on Wednesday.

The contract covers about $80 million in property insurance, while the rest covers insurance against losses from possible breaks in operations, acting head of the Fire Insurance Department Marina Sennikova told a news conference.
The $100 million risk was re-insured, she said.
In 1995 Ingosstrakh paid over $250,000 in indemnity to Comstar after its equipment was damaged by fire, it said in a statement.
